blocks.text: A CPA in Tampa Discusses Writing a Business Plan

It’s obvious that a new company must formulate a well-conceived business plan. Less obvious is the need even for established companies to maintain a business plan that is flexible enough to adjust as challenges and goals evolve over the years. Without a sound business plan, employees, management, and customers might find themselves at odds about expectations, which can erode employee morale, harm the customer-company relationship, and threaten profitability.

A [CPA in Tampa](http://www.reliancecpa.com/) from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can help your company’s management team formulate a business plan that will create the proper structure for your business, streamline procedures, outline a company philosophy, and make sure that the talents and abilities of your people are being incorporated to their fullest extent.
